items.synopsis: The l2cpd telemetry crash would be observed when the LLDP Netconf notification from external controllers along with Netconf services configuration is present on the device
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, configuring Link Layer Discovery Protocol (LLDP) with "system services netconf notification" enabled will trigger the l2cpd crash. This crash causes the CPU to spike.

items.category: PFE L2 forwarding features on BT based platforms
items.synopsis: Protocol hello/keep-alive may not work on the Mac accounting interface.
items.description: Protocol hello/keep-alive may not work on the Mac accounting interface.

items.synopsis: The host outbound traffic drop is seen on all Junos OS Evolved platforms due to a race condition between class-of-service host-outbound-traffic and forwarding-class configuration update
items.description: Host outbound forwarding-class/queue mapping does not take effect as expected per configurations on all Junos OS Evolved platforms. Host outbound queue is not getting correctly programmed and caused a traffic drop.

items.category: Issues related to EVO interface statistics.
items.synopsis: MAC accounting information cannot be confirmed on Junos Evolved PTX10001-36MR platform
items.description: On Junos Evolved PTX10001-36MR platform, even in the presence of MAC(Media access Control) accounting configuration, 'show interface mac-database ' command will not exhibit any data. Due to this issue, MAC accounting statistics will not be displayed.

items.synopsis: [dhcp] [DHCP_RELAY] ACX7100-48L :: Getting commit error for the dhcp config commit and then it is coring with the bt jtimer_start_oneshot
items.description: During commit of configuration related to active-leasquery requires initialization of timers. However, in Junos Evolved system, the timers were not initialized correctly. This caused commit check error.

items.synopsis: On PTX10001-36MR the VXLAN tunnel termination functionality impacted with global configuration not enabled
items.description: On Junos Evolved PTX10001-36MR platform, the VXLAN (Virtual Extensible LAN) tunnel termination functionality will be impacted when configuration is not enabled for tunnel termination. As the tunnel will not get terminated this will impact the packet forwarding process.

items.synopsis: The rpd process might crash when SPF is recalculated
items.description: On all Junos and Junos Evolved platforms, the rpd (Routing Protocol Daemon) process can crash due to periodic SPF (Shortest Path first) recalculation when ISIS (Intermediate System to Intermediate System) connected or direct routes get deleted.

items.category: EVO VXLAN PFE for BCM XGS Platforms
items.synopsis: EVO based QFX5K switches (QFX5130-32CD) - EVPN VXLAN ECMP routing does not happen when underlay L3 link flaps
items.description: On EVO based QFX5K switches (like QFX5130-32CD), in a VXLAN deployment , Type-2 Overlay ECMP routing may not happen when the underlay L3 interface is flapped.

items.synopsis: New CLI commands addition to support RE and Chassis power-cycle
items.description: New CLI commands addition to support RE and Chassis power-cycle under request vmhost hierarchy

items.synopsis: Traffic loss is seen on RTG bound interface
items.description: On all Junos and Junos OS Evolved platforms, configuring mac-move with action shutdown can disable the RTG (Redundant Trunk Groups) interface leading to traffic loss bound to that interface.

items.category: Gnats category for dynamic rendering infrastructure
items.synopsis: evo-aftmand-zx not responding, ping, arp not working after unsubscribing some telemetry sensors.
items.description: After unsubscribing certain telemetry sensors, evo-aftmand-zx becomes unresponsive due to a deadlock problem.

items.synopsis: Junos Evolved - fibd object-info anomalies observed@net:: juniper:: addrwatch:: AddrWatchNotify
items.description: On a system running Junos Evolved software with GRES configured. The fibd process may not free object memories after they are no longer needed. This causes an error message such as "object-info anomalies observed".

items.synopsis: Junos Evolved software:: System is hanging when extend-db is configured and config > 680MB is loaded.
items.description: In EVO, during scaled config commit, Configd daemon in UI-infra is taking more time to process the commit. To optimise the processing time, most likely there will be design change required. There is no LKWR/pass instance. Also based on the configuration scale and the time taken for the commit to complete, it seems that this is a Day-1 issue.

items.synopsis: JDI_REG:: EVO:Scapa[BFD]: one of the BFD state is down after Performing BT Restart"
items.description: This issue is seen during CLI triggered onlining of the PFE, i.e., when "request chassis fpc slot pfe restart" is executed. Please use the workaround provided.

items.synopsis: QFX5130 / QFX5220 EVO : Link up failure on 10G SFP+ ports.
items.description: On QFX5130(EVO) and QFX5220(EVO), 10G SFP+ links will not come up after booting up.

items.synopsis: BNG Controller: L2TP LAC functionality is not working in this release
items.description: L2TP LAC functionality is not working in this release

items.category: UI Infrastructure - mgd, DAX API, DDL/ODL
items.synopsis: MX960 :: CST:RE goes to amnesiac state, when rebooting the DUT -mgd: error: translation script failure
items.description: When a toggle attribute with variable is committed under dynamic-profiles hierarchy, upon reboot system will go to amnesiac mode

items.synopsis: Observed evo-aftmand-zx core at je_malloc_mutex_lock (mutex=0xa70) at include/jemalloc/internal/mutex.h:85
items.description: An evo-aftmand-zx core might be seen during or after FPC restart with mutlicast config on Brackla (ptx10003). After crash when the system comes up the system will be in a stable state with multicast routes
